title: Gourmet Adventure in Quebec City Prestige Culinary Experience
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the authentic flavors of Quebec City on a 4-hour gastronomic adventure. A vehicle transports you to 4 to 5 carefully selected restaurants where you can enjoy local dishes and innovative creations. Each stop offers a unique dining experience, allowing you to discover hidden gems of the city. Whether for a couple looking for a private experience or a small group, this tour promises a personalized gastronomic journey. Enjoy walks through the picturesque streets of Quebec City, accompanied by anecdotes and tips from your Guide.

 - Private or small group tour for an intimate experience
 - 4 to 5 stops at exclusive restaurants highlighting local cuisine
 - Discovery of hidden culinary gems in Quebec City
 - Pick up and drop off at the Inn included
